case.summary: This alert was triggered by the message: "Real-time model scored transaction 3640919 ($881.55) at 0.71. Review and decide." on card C09241-K2. Graph evidence showed that while the transaction amount is in the top 3 percent for this card, the card has 491 prior purchases in the same billing region, and the transaction model scored it very low at 0.005. However, a data discrepancy exists because the case record and the bank transaction record name different cards. A simulated reply indicates an analyst was asked to reconcile the card records but has not answered yet. The verdict is uncertain, and the final actions are CREATE_CASE, MONITOR_CARD, VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER, and ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST.
